final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS status, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS status_avg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref COLLATE BINARY = t.telescregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.equipstatus), overall AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS avg_value FROM status_avgs), first_kept AS (SELECT a.status, a.status_avg, a.status_avg - o.avg_value AS first_difference FROM status_avgs AS a JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_value IS NOT NULL WHERE a.status_avg > o.avg_value), second_overall AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) AS avg_value FROM first_kept), second_kept AS (SELECT f.status_avg, f.first_difference, f.status_avg - o.avg_value AS second_difference FROM first_kept AS f JOIN second_overall AS o ON o.avg_value IS NOT NULL WHERE f.status_avg > o.avg_value) SELECT AVG(status_avg), AVG(first_difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM second_kept
